The '''Nirellia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Oktos sector/Legends|Oktos sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Nirellian ground-slug]]s.<ref name="Mandalorian Armor" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nirellia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square Q-11.<ref name="TEA" />
